# Provenance

Unmodified snapshot of the other team's repository, used by this project as the model to monitor.

* Source: https://github.com/Nisarg7314/customer-churn-mlops.git
* Commit: ee945bb1b3f5aa3bbffecae9051da7da883b9dcf
* Purpose here: (1) the MLflow/skops model artifact under `model/` is served (with one bug fix) by
  `services/model_api`; (2) the original image is built as-is by `docker-compose.second-model.yml`
  to demonstrate that the monitoring stack wraps a model **without any code changes**.

Nothing in this folder is edited by Team 4.
